verdict.rationale: Unit-testing agents is a fair axis for an agent orchestration framework, but the evidence pack never documents mocking models or tools, fake LLMs, or a unit-testing harness. The 'Local development & testing' page covers local server environments (langgraph dev/up), not mocked unit tests. The community note that nodes are plain functions is at most a developer building block, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit-test agents with mocked models and tools
